SELECT *
FROM obt_trade

SELECT reason_code AS reasonCode, reason_desc AS reasonDesc, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM obt_trade
WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND trade_type = 2
GROUP BY reason_code, reason_desc
ORDER BY cnt DESC
